changelog.title: Apple Liquid Glass Overhaul, 4-Tab Capsule & Native Folder Unpacker
changes: Pure iOS/visionOS Liquid Glass Design System with Specular Edges
Permanently eliminated top horizontal scrollbars with 4-tab streamlined navigation
Sequential Queue Worker for high-throughput multi-file transfers

changelog.title: Clean Local Mesh Engine & Fast Cloud Auto-Update Sync
changes: Stable Real Wi-Fi & Hotspot Device Discovery (Mesh Engine)
Zero-latency WebRTC direct LAN file streaming
Purged all backend shell loops for 100% lightweight CPU performance
Automatic screen wake lock on mobile receiver
Clean Mesh Room HUD with dynamic public IP and room hash indicator

changelog.title: Nearby Radar, Ephemeral Notebook & Zero-ZIP Auto Upgrade Engine
changes: Nearby Radar: 360 sweeping radar scanning for local Wi-Fi devices
AirDrop-style Handshake Modal: Recipient must explicitly Accept or Decline incoming transfer
Zero-ZIP 1-Click Auto Upgrade: Instant in-place rebuild and reload directly inside Chrome
Smart Notebook Engine: Auto-detects notes, code syntax (JS/Python/SQL), and URL web cards

changelog.title: BeamDrop Ephemeral Live Notebook & Pure OTA Engine
changes: Interactive Digital Notebook page: Scanned text, code, and links open directly in an interactive notebook
Multi-file in-memory ZIP bundling with JSZip

changelog.title: Automated Package Downloader & Dual GitHub/Vercel Sync
changes: Direct chrome.downloads API integration: downloads new extension.zip directly to user machine
Dual-cloud polling: Checks Vercel + raw.githubusercontent.com simultaneously with cache-busting
